mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers a tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or 20-day returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST rise in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly higher than a baseline model excluding the interaction term (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect diminishes in 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% in a high-unemployment environment indicates labor market stress, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) reflects expanding economic activity, boosting equity valuations and corporate earnings expectations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 60-day returns in expanding periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105.0 signals supply-side expansion, reducing production costs and increasing corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the effect diminishes in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Parallel increases in monthly employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) in the same month indicate conflicting labor market signals, causing market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both PAYEMS and UNRATE rise in the same month
failure_condition: Interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or returns are not consistently negative in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% increases discount rates, compresses equity valuations, and reduces future cash flow expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in < 40% of triggered instances during tightening cycles, or returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in such periods.
